description: This file contains the implementation of a JSON serializer for the JJWT (Java JWT) library. The class JjwtSerializer converts Java objects into JSON byte arrays, handling various data types such as primitives, collections, maps, dates, and byte arrays. It provides a singleton access method and leverages the JsonFactory for JSON construction.

classes.name: JjwtSerializer
classes.description: A final class providing JSON serialization of Java objects for the JJWT library, implementing the Serializer interface with singleton access.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JjwtSerializer.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Java object into a UTF-8 encoded JSON byte array.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts a Java object into a JsonValue, handling various data types like primitives, collections, maps, dates, and byte arrays.

methods.name: toJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a Map into a JsonObject, with stringified keys.

methods.name: toJsonArray
methods.description: Converts a Collection into a JsonArray.
